_comment: This is the spellwright's registry ledger, reduced to its schema shape plus ONE worked example entry. A guild running its own prompt system grows this array — one entry per active or historical run-order plan, each pointing at a durable plan file and its planning artifacts.

plans.title: Canonical Master Workflow
plans.description: Top-level current-state workflow plan. Uses the single canonical main workflow model — the run order that names which prompt pack is active, which are supporting, and which are historical.
